# Diabetes Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened related to Diabetes.

## Scope note

Broader grouping for diabetes-related HealthEvent subtypes (GlucoseEvent, InsulinEvent); relates to WeekDiabetes/WeekDiabetesAnalysis at the weekly rollup.
